scope.instruction: Fully static Astro 7 site: every page is prerendered at build time and served as static files by nginx (Dockerfile). No SSR, no API routes, no backend. Known attacker-reachable inputs: (1) Ghost CMS post HTML injected via set:html in src/pages/blog/[...slug].astro — evaluate XSS impact if the CMS is compromised; (2) the contact form in src/pages/contact.astro posts to the external FormSubmit.co service (honeypot _honey field, _captcha disabled); (3) localStorage-based dark mode script in BaseLayout.astro; (4) URLs listed in src/data/portfolio.ts. Critical invariant to verify: the Ghost Content API key (env CONTENT_API_KEY, GHOST_URL) used at build time must NOT leak into any client-visible output in dist/ (JS bundles, HTML, sitemap). src/components/ui/** is vendored shadcn-vue components mostly unused by pages — deprioritize but report if reachable. Also review Dockerfile/nginx static serving configuration and the Astro/Vite build configuration in astro.config.mjs.
